title_en: Te Liqini Thate, Super Penthouse 3+1+2 with Veranda for sale!!
description_en: Te Liqini Thate, Super Penthouse 3+1+2 With Porch for Sale!!! The penthouse is located on the sixth and last floor of a new building equipped with an elevator, currently under renovation. The apartment has a total area of ​​197.6 m2, of which 43.5 m2 is the veranda area. The apartment is organized in the living room with the kitchen area and access to the veranda, three bedrooms, two bathrooms with windows and a super veranda. The orientation of the apartment from the east, south and west, as well as the open view, allow sun and natural lighting throughout the day. The apartment also has two parking spaces with an extra value of 35,000 euros each. The area in which it is located is one of the most sought after for a comfortable lifestyle as well as for investment due to the high demand for rent.
